blocks.text: Bolivar Heights Homes for Sale | Surrey BC MLS

parts.t: Bolivar Heights sits on the slope just north of Surrey City Centre, between the towers around Surrey Central and the trails of Invergarry Park. Most of it is older detached homes on regular lots, with a few apartment buildings near the City Centre edge. This page lists what's for sale here right now.

I've been a REALTOR® since 2015, with more than $500M in sales. I grew up on a farm in Langley and I live there again now, so the north side of Surrey is a short drive for me, not a stranger's map. Read my
Bolivar Heights neighbourhood guide
or compare all
North Surrey homes for sale
Written by
Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®

Invergarry Park, at 11285 Surrey Road, is the big one: more than 37 hectares of forest and trails dropping toward the Fraser. Bolivar Park on Crestview Drive is the closer, everyday park for many streets.

James Ardiel Elementary is on 112 Avenue, and Surrey Traditional is nearby on 113 Avenue. High school catchments here are split between Kwantlen Park Secondary and L.A. Matheson, so don't assume. Check the exact address in the Surrey Schools School Locator.
Bus 373 serves the neighbourhood, and the SkyTrain stations in City Centre are a short ride south. City Centre Library on University Drive is the nearest branch.
The City of Surrey's City Centre Plan is being updated, and the update allows more growth in Bolivar Heights. If you buy here, look at what the plan says for your lot and the lots beside you. My
Surrey land use plans
page links the City documents.

Bolivar Heights tends to suit people who want a house and a yard but still want to be close to City Centre jobs and SkyTrain. You get older homes with room to update, and streets that are quieter than the blocks right around the stations.

It may suit you less if you want a brand-new home with no work to do, or if you'd rather not live near an area that's planned to change. The plan update means more homes could be built here over time. Some buyers see that as a reason to buy, others as a reason to look elsewhere.

If you own here, the buyer pool usually includes families moving up from a City Centre condo and people who want a lot with potential. I'll walk through your home, tell you what buyers will notice first, and show you what similar homes have sold for before we set a price.

blocks.text: What I look at with Bolivar Heights buyers

parts.t: The age of the roof, furnace, wiring and drains in older houses
Whether a suite was built with permits
How the lot slopes and drains, since much of the area is on a hillside
What the updated City Centre Plan allows next door

It's in North Surrey, just north of Surrey City Centre, running up toward Invergarry Park and the Fraser River.

blocks.text: What kind of homes are in Bolivar Heights?

parts.t: Mostly older detached houses on regular lots, plus a few apartment buildings near City Centre.

blocks.text: Which high school serves Bolivar Heights?

parts.t: It depends on the address. Parts of the area go to Kwantlen Park Secondary and parts to L.A. Matheson. Use the Surrey Schools School Locator.

blocks.text: Is Bolivar Heights part of the City Centre Plan update?

parts.t: Yes. The City's update allows more growth in Bolivar Heights, so check the plan for the lot you're looking at.

blocks.text: Is there a big park nearby?

parts.t: Invergarry Park, at 11285 Surrey Road, has more than 37 hectares of forest and trails.

blocks.text: Can I walk to SkyTrain from Bolivar Heights?

parts.t: From the south edge, yes, it's walkable to City Centre. From streets further north you'll likely take the bus.

blocks.text: Which elementary schools are in Bolivar Heights?

parts.t: James Ardiel Elementary on 112 Avenue and Surrey Traditional on 113 Avenue are in the area. Check the Surrey Schools School Locator for the catchment of a specific address.
